paragraphs: Hyman concludes that he was a student of Rabbi Mana, since, as Hyman observes, he is always found asking Rabbi Mana questions: Maaserot, chapter 1, at the end of halakhah 4; Shabbat, chapter 3, halakhah 5; Pesachim, chapter 7, halakhah 7; Nazir, chapter 9, halakhah 3; Avodah Zarah, chapter 1, halakhah 9.[^1]

notes.text: שבעי is the ordinary asking formula; the source lists five passages illustrating the teacher-student relationship.
